hook: Ranger Sam phones the class from Pine Hollow Park over a crackly line. Pick the question word that gets the missing part, ask a follow-up, and fill the message pad.
outcome: Listen for what is missing when static eats a word, choose the question word (Who, What, Where, When, Why, How) that gets it, ask a follow-up on the topic, answer questions about key details, and recount the call in order
